hinglish.imports.title: Products import karein
hinglish.imports.help: Excel ya CSV se product list laayein. Save karne se pehle sab check karein.
hinglish.imports.template_help: Template ke column names rakhein. Barcode text mein rakhein. Update mein khaali cell purani value rakhta hai.
hinglish.imports.stock_help: Opening stock sirf naye products ke liye hai. Sirf owner stock import kar sakta hai. Maujooda stock nahi badlega.
hinglish.imports.file_limit: .xlsx ya UTF-8 .csv • 10 MB aur 5,000 rows tak
hinglish.imports.refresh: Review refresh karein / saved result dekhein
hinglish.imports.review_help: Price, stock aur matches check karein. Gair-zaroori rows skip karein ya file theek karein.
hinglish.imports.mapping_help: Har field ko file column se match karein. Khaali category mein neeche wali category lagegi.
hinglish.imports.state.applying: Kuch save hua · import jaari rakhein
hinglish.imports.confirm: Ye checked changes save karein? Prices aur naye products ka stock batches mein save hoga.
hinglish.imports.error.failed: Kaam poora nahi hua. Saved import rakha hai. Retry karein ya result dekhein.
hinglish.imports.error.unavailable: Is server par imports abhi enabled nahi hain. Maujooda products Products mein milenge.
hinglish.imports.error.stale_review: Review ke baad products badle hain. Aage badhne se pehle review refresh karein.
hinglish.imports.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner ya manager products import kar sakte hain.
hinglish.imports.error.invalid_file: File read nahi hui. Values-only copy save karke retry karein.
hinglish.imports.error.too_large: File import limit se badi hai. Chhoti files mein baantein.
hinglish.imports.error.resolve_errors: Save se pehle issue wali rows theek karein ya skip karein.
hinglish.imports.field.name: Product naam
hinglish.imports.issue.name_required: Product naam zaroori hai (200 characters tak).
hinglish.imports.issue.values_only: Formula ki jagah text ya values rakhein. Codes text cells mein rakhein.
hinglish.imports.issue.identifier_invalid: Barcode ya short code bahut lamba hai.
hinglish.imports.issue.existing_product: Product pehle se hai. Skip karein ya Update existing products chunein.
hinglish.imports.issue.ambiguous_product: Ek se zyada products mile. Barcode ya short code theek karein.
hinglish.imports.issue.archived_product: Product archived hai. Update se pehle restore karein.
hinglish.imports.issue.no_match: Existing product nahi mila. Barcode, short code ya naam check karein.
hinglish.imports.issue.duplicate_file: Ye row file mein product ya code repeat karti hai.
hinglish.imports.issue.category_invalid: Shop ke liye sahi category aur subcategory chunein.
hinglish.imports.issue.unit_invalid: kg, g, L, mL, piece, packet, dozen ya crate likhein.
hinglish.imports.issue.unit_change: Import se existing product ki unit nahi badal sakte.
hinglish.imports.issue.number_invalid: Sahi decimals wala zero ya positive number dein; reorder level whole number ho.
hinglish.imports.issue.owner_stock: Sirf owner opening stock import kar sakta hai.
hinglish.imports.issue.stock_update: Opening stock existing stock ko overwrite nahi kar sakta.
hinglish.imports.issue.service_stock: Services ka opening stock nahi ho sakta.
hinglish.imports.issue.above_mrp: Selling price MRP se zyada nahi ho sakta.
hinglish.imports.issue.text_long: Is value ko 200 characters tak chhota karein.
hinglish.imports.issue.cost_unknown: Cost pata nahi; margin adhoora hoga.
hinglish.imports.issue.unpriced: Selling price nahi hai; bechne se pehle jodein.
hinglish.imports.preview_notice: Local test shop · Live data nahi. Yahan import sirf local test data badalta hai.
hinglish.products.title: Products
hinglish.catalog.l2.cement-putty: Cement, bag wali ret, putty, tile lots
hinglish.partiesImport.help: Excel ya CSV se purane contacts aur unke opening balance laayein. Save karne se pehle har row check kar lein.
hinglish.partiesImport.template_help: Template column ke naam use karein. Phone number, GSTIN aur state code ko text mein hi rakhein. Khaali update cells se purani details bani rahengi.
hinglish.partiesImport.supplier_required: Purane supplier directory ke liye suppliers ko address aur do digit ka state code chahiye. Unregistered suppliers ke liye GSTIN optional hai.
hinglish.partiesImport.customer_balance_help: Positive opening balance: customer ka aapki dukaan par paisa baki hai. Negative: aapki dukaan ka customer par paisa baki hai.
hinglish.partiesImport.supplier_balance_help: Positive opening balance: aapki dukaan ka supplier par paisa baki hai. Negative: supplier ka aapki dukaan par paisa baki hai. Yeh starting balance recorded purchase invoice se alag hota hai.
hinglish.partiesImport.balance_help: Sirf owner hi opening balance la sakta hai. Aaj ki ya usse pehli date use karein. Jis party ka opening balance ya recorded transaction hai, use doosra opening balance nahi diya ja sakta. Sirf contacts import karne ke liye cell ko khaali chhod dein.
hinglish.partiesImport.confirm: Kya in check kiye gaye contacts aur opening balance ko save karna hai? Purane transactions waise hi rahenge.
hinglish.partiesImport.save: Check kiye gaye contacts import karein
hinglish.partiesImport.no_history: Abhi tak koi contact import nahi hua hai.
hinglish.partiesImport.profile_retry: Contact details load nahi ho payi. Retry karne ke liye tap karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.field.name: Contact ka naam
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.text_long: Yeh text bahut lamba hai. File mein ise chhota karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.values_only: Identifiers ke liye sirf plain text use karein. Formula aur link ki jagah values daalein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.gstin: Sahi check digit ke saath sahi GSTIN daalein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.state: Agar supplier ki detail di hai, toh GSTIN se match karne wala sahi do digit ka state code chunein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.address_state: Suppliers aur GST-registered contacts ke liye address aur state code zaroori hai.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.amount: Amount mein zyada se zyada do decimal place ka istemal karein, jo ₹9,999,999,999.99 tak ho.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.owner_balance: Sirf owner hi opening balance import kar sakta hai. Contact import karne ke liye is cell ko khaali chhod dein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.balance_exists: Is contact ka pehle se hi starting balance ya recorded transactions hain. Sirf contact details import karein, aur opening balance khaali chhod dein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.ambiguous: Ek se zyada contacts match ho rahe hain. Import karne se pehle naam, phone ya GSTIN theek karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.archived: Yeh contact archive ho chuka hai. Badlav import karne se pehle ise restore karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.exists: Yeh contact pehle se maujood hai. Update existing contacts chunein, ya is row ko skip karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.not_found: Koi bhi maujooda contact is row se match nahi karta. Add new contacts chunein, ya iske identifiers theek karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.issue.duplicate_file: Doosri kisi row mein bhi yahi naam, phone, GSTIN ya target contact hai. Ek row rakhein aur duplicate ko skip karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.mapping_help: Har contact field ko file ke column se match karein. Purani details rakhne ke liye fields ko unmapped chhod dein.
hinglish.partiesImport.review_help: Check karein ki contact match ho rahe hain aur dated opening balances sahi hain. Anchahe rows ko skip karein ya import karne se pehle file ko theek karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.error.unavailable: Is server par contact import available nahi hain. Maujooda contacts apni directories mein hi rahenge.
hinglish.partiesImport.error.stale_review: Aapke review ke baad contacts ya balances badal gaye hain. Aage badhne se pehle review refresh karein.
hinglish.partiesImport.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner ya manager hi contacts import kar sakta hai. Opening balances ke liye owner hona zaroori hai.
hinglish.barcodes.title: Product barcodes
hinglish.barcodes.help: Products ko ek internal code do, ya pehle se save kiya hua barcode download karo. Purane manufacturer codes waise hi rahenge.
hinglish.barcodes.internal_help: Samaan Bol codes Code 128 use karte hain aur aapki dukan ke andar kaam karte hain. Ye registered retail GTINs nahi hain.
hinglish.barcodes.online_help: Code banane ya badalne ke liye internet connection chahiye. Cache mein maujood purani barcode images tab tak milengi jab tak cache hai.
hinglish.barcodes.generate_on_save: Koi barcode nahi? Save karte time ek bana lo
hinglish.barcodes.generate_confirm: {{count}} select kiye gaye products ke liye codes banaein? Pehle se save kiye gaye koi bhi codes waise hi rahenge.
hinglish.barcodes.select_missing: Is view mein missing codes select karo
hinglish.barcodes.missing: Abhi tak koi barcode nahi hai
hinglish.barcodes.png_help: Print karte time white border aur original image ka size vaisa hi rakhein. Padhne wala text save kiya hua code hai.
hinglish.barcodes.result: Banaaye gaye {{generated}} · Bachaye gaye {{preserved}} · Badle gaye {{replaced}}
hinglish.barcodes.check_result: Save hua result check karo / dobara try karo
hinglish.barcodes.uncertain: Doosra change shuru karne se pehle save hua result check kar lein. Dobara try karne par yehi request use hogi.
hinglish.barcodes.empty: Is view mein koi product nahi hai.
hinglish.barcodes.conflict_help: Ye codes ek se zyada products ke hain. Jab tak manager in products ko alag codes dekar re-label nahi karta, tab tak scanning block rahegi.
hinglish.barcodes.aliases: Purane labels jo abhi bhi kaam kar rahe hain
hinglish.barcodes.replace_help: Isko sirf jaan-boojhkar label badalne ke liye use karein. Purana unique code is product se link rahega, isliye purane labels kaam karte rahenge. Stock, keematein aur nikli hui bills vaisi hi rahengi.
hinglish.barcodes.reason: Is label ko badalne ka reason
hinglish.barcodes.replace_confirm: {{name}} ka primary code replace karein? Aage badhne se pehle naye label ko dekh lein.
hinglish.barcodes.preserving: Purane labels ko surakshit rakhne ke liye yahan maujooda code manage karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.failed: Barcode save ya load nahi ho saka. Save kiya hua result check karein, ya refresh karke phir se try karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.invalid: 1–100 printable characters wala plain-text barcode istemal karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner ya manager hi code generate ya replace kar sakte hain.
hinglish.barcodes.error.not_found: Yeh product ya save kiya hua request is dukan mein uplabdha nahi hai.
hinglish.barcodes.error.archived: Yeh code kisi archived ya delete kiye gaye product ka hai. Ise review karne ke liye manager se kahein; ise dobara assign nahi kiya ja sakta.
hinglish.barcodes.error.ambiguous: Ek se zyada product is code ka istemal kar rahe hain. Scan karne se pehle manager se duplicate solve karayein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.conflict: Yeh code pehle se hi kisi doosre product ke liye reserve hai, jisme purana label bhi shamil hai. Koi doosra code istemal karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.reserved: SB- codes Samaan Bol dwara allot kiye jate hain. Khud se code dalne ke bajaye Generate code istemal karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.replace_required: Wajah ke saath maujooda code ko replace karne ke liye Manage barcode istemal karein. Current code surakshit rakh liya gaya hai.
hinglish.barcodes.error.invalid_request: 100 tak product chunein, ya kam se kam 5 characters ki wajah ke saath naya code dalein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.request_conflict: Yeh request save kiye gaye change se match nahi karti. Aage badhne se pehle product refresh karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.request_missing: Is request ke liye koi change save nahi hua tha. Wahi selection submit karne ke liye dobara try karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.missing: Image download karne se pehle barcode generate karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.stale: Ise kholne ke baad yeh code change ho gaya hai. Refresh karein aur current label review karein.
hinglish.barcodes.error.unavailable: Is server par barcode tools uplabdha nahi hain. Maujooda product uplabdha rahenge.
hinglish.barcodes.error.unprintable: Is save kiye gaye code ko Code 128 ke roop mein render nahi kiya ja sakta. Iska original text surakshit hai aur ise copy kiya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.barcodes.activity_generated: {{name}} ke liye internal barcode generate kiya gaya
hinglish.barcodes.activity_replaced: {{name}} ke primary barcode ko replace kiya gaya
hinglish.imports.error.barcode_replace_required: Maujooda barcode ko jaan-boojhkar replace karne ki zaroorat hai. Manage barcode istemal karein, ya is import mein iske barcode cell ko khali chhod dein.
hinglish.bulk.title: Bulk product editing
hinglish.bulk.edit_selected: {{count}} select kiye gaye products edit karein
hinglish.bulk.help: Badalne ke liye fields chunein, har product check karein, phir check kiye gaye batch ko save karein.
hinglish.bulk.protected: Stock, units, barcodes, GST confirmation aur historical costs ke liye alag flow hain. Purchase cost yahan nahi badla jata.
hinglish.bulk.cart_help: Purane carts ki pakki hui prices waisi hi rahengi. Billing se pehle un prices ko check kar lein; naye carts updated catalogue use karenge.
hinglish.bulk.batch_help: Selection lock ho gayi hai. {{limit}} products tak ka har batch alag se check aur save hota hai.
hinglish.bulk.batch: Batch {{batch}} of {{batches}} · {{total}} products select kiye gaye
hinglish.bulk.mode.subtract: Amount ke hisaab se kam karein
hinglish.bulk.mode.decrease_percent: Percent ke hisaab se kam karein
hinglish.bulk.rounding: Prices najdeeki paise tak round honge (₹1.005 → ₹1.01). Khali field ka matlab zero nahi hai.
hinglish.bulk.refresh: Current products se is batch ko refresh karein
hinglish.bulk.refresh_help: Conflict check karne ke baad hi refresh karein. Isse lock ki gayi selection bani rehti hai aur is batch ke current values dobara load ho jate hain.
hinglish.bulk.confirm: Maine is batch ke purane aur naye values check kar liye hain. In changes ko ek saath save karein.
hinglish.bulk.no_changes: Is product ke liye koi field change nahi hai.
hinglish.bulk.no_history: Abhi tak koi bulk selection nahi hai.
hinglish.bulk.recover: Saved result check karein / retry karein
hinglish.bulk.uncertain: Response confirm nahi hua. Koi aur change shuru karne se pehle is request ko check karein ya retry karein.
hinglish.bulk.gst_link: Product GST alag se review karein
hinglish.bulk.error.invalid_request: Sirf supported fields aur valid values chunein.
hinglish.bulk.error.no_fields: Change karne ke liye kam se kam ek field chunein.
hinglish.bulk.error.invalid_price: Do decimal places tak ka non-negative amount daalein. Adjusted prices supported range ke andar hi rehne chahiye.
hinglish.bulk.error.missing_price: Jin products ki pehle se koi price nahi hai, unke liye pehle amount set karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner ya manager hi bulk product changes review aur apply kar sakte hain.
hinglish.bulk.error.not_found: Yeh saved selection is shop aur account ke liye available nahi hai.
hinglish.bulk.error.selection_changed: Kuch selected products unavailable ya archived hain. Product list refresh karein aur dobara select karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.request_conflict: Yeh request saved selection se alag hai. Aage badhne se pehle saved result open karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.empty: Is selection se koi active product match nahi hota.
hinglish.bulk.error.too_many: 10,000 tak products chunein, ya search aur filter ko narrow karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.stale_review: Review change ho gaya hai. Saved selection reload karein aur ise dobara review karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.already_applied: Yeh batch pehle hi save ho chuka tha. Kisi doosre uncompleted batch ke saath continue karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.resolve_errors: Is batch ko save karne se pehle highlighted rows ko resolve karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.nothing_changed: Is batch mein save karne ke liye koi change nahi hai.
hinglish.bulk.error.unavailable: Is server par bulk editing unavailable hai. Update ready hone ke baad refresh karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.failed: Result confirm nahi ho saka. Retry karne se pehle saved selection check karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.stale: Selection ke baad yeh product change ho gaya. Is batch ka koi bhi hissa save nahi hua. Is batch ko refresh karein aur dobara review karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.category_invalid: Is shop ke liye available category aur subcategory chunein.
hinglish.bulk.error.item_type: Stock item aur service ke beech change karne ke liye alag product review ki zaroorat hoti hai.
hinglish.bulk.error.no_stock: Reorder levels aur depletion order sirf stock-tracked products par apply hote hain.
hinglish.bulk.error.tax_unknown: MRP limit ke saath price change karne se pehle is product ki GST settings review karein.
hinglish.bulk.error.above_mrp: Applicable GST sahit customer price MRP se zyada nahi hona chahiye.
hinglish.bulk.warning.cart_prices: Existing cart prices retain rahenge. Billing se pehle unhe review karein.
hinglish.documents.title: Branding aur formats
hinglish.documents.help: Nayi bills ka look set karein. Pehle se bani hui documents ki details waisi hi rahengi.
hinglish.documents.language_help: Yeh bhasha har nayi bill ke saath bani rahegi, bhale hi baad mein app ki bhasha badal jaye.
hinglish.documents.cover: Jagah bharne ke liye crop karein
hinglish.documents.signature_enable: Nayi bills par yeh signature print karein
hinglish.documents.signature_help: Signature ka PNG ya JPEG istemal karein. Yeh sirf is dukaan ke liye private hai aur yeh koi cryptographic digital signature nahi hai.
hinglish.documents.image_help: PNG ya JPEG, 2 MB aur 4 million pixels tak. Images bina stretch kiye fit hoti hain; pehle se bani hui documents ki images waisi hi rahengi.
hinglish.documents.payment_toggle: Set kiye gaye UPI payment details print karein
hinglish.documents.payment_help: Payments aur bills mein pehle se set kiye gaye payee aur UPI details ka istemal karta hai. Save karne se pehle check kar lein.
hinglish.documents.payment_caption: Payment details paise milne ki pushti nahi karti. Record kiye gaye payment status ko check karein.
hinglish.documents.payment_missing: Abhi tak koi UPI payment details set nahi kiye gaye hain.
hinglish.documents.terms_help: Optional, 2,000 characters tak. Lambe terms doosre page par aage badhte hain.
hinglish.documents.identity_help: Logo aur footer sirf sajawat ke liye hain. GST documents ki legal identity aur tax details waisi hi rahengi.
hinglish.documents.save: Nayi bills ke liye save karein
hinglish.documents.saved: Nayi bills ke liye branding save ho gayi.
hinglish.documents.saved_earlier: Aapka version save ho gaya tha, lekin current profile phir se badal gaya. Doosra badlav karne se pehle reload karein.
hinglish.documents.unsaved: Preview mein ye unsave kiye gaye badlav dikhenge. Koi invoice number ya sale nahi banegi.
hinglish.documents.preview_help: Save karne se pehle logo, signature, terms aur page breaks check kar lein.
hinglish.documents.sample_help: This preview does not record a sale, stock movement, payment or invoice number.
hinglish.documents.original_caption: Original issued presentation. Branding and language are retained with this document.
hinglish.documents.print_opened: Print dialog opened. The bill has not changed.
hinglish.documents.signature_caption: Signature image · not a digital signature
hinglish.documents.profile_none: Abhi tak koi branding profile save nahi hui hai. Purane bills apne original receipt format mein dikhenge.
hinglish.documents.online_help: Branding save karne aur images upload karne ke liye internet chahiye. Save kiye gaye bills apni original profile mein hi rahenge.
hinglish.documents.not_owner: Branding sirf dukaan ka maalik hi badal sakta hai. Dukaan ke baaki members sirf unhi save kiye gaye documents ko dekh sakte hain jinka unhe access hai.
hinglish.documents.check_result: Saved result check karein / retry karein
hinglish.documents.uncertain: Save ka response confirm nahi hua. Koi aur change karne se pehle is request ko check ya retry karein.
hinglish.documents.error.invalid: Layout, language, chuni hui images aur terms check karein.
hinglish.documents.error.not_allowed: Aapke paas in shop document settings ko badalne ya kholne ki permission nahi hai.
hinglish.documents.error.not_found: Yeh document ya profile is dukaan aur account ke liye uplabdha nahi hai.
hinglish.documents.error.stale: Branding profile kahin aur badal di gayi hai. Ise reload karein aur apne changes dobara check karein.
hinglish.documents.error.request_conflict: Yeh request save ki gayi request se alag hai. Aage badhne se pehle current profile ko reload karein.
hinglish.documents.error.image_invalid: Koi valid PNG ya JPEG chunein. Animated images aur doosre file types support nahi hote.
hinglish.documents.error.image_dimensions: Aisi image chunein jisme zyada se zyada 4 million pixels hon aur koi bhi side 4,096 pixels se lambi na ho.
hinglish.documents.error.signature_required: Print karne se pehle signature image upload karein.
hinglish.documents.error.asset_missing: Image uplabdha nahi hai. Profile reload karein ya ise phir se upload karein.
hinglish.documents.error.invalid_context: Retained branding reference galat hai. Original document reload karein.
hinglish.documents.error.context_missing: Is server par original branding uplabdha nahi hai. Save ki gayi bill rakhein aur reconnect karein ya server update karein.
hinglish.documents.error.integrity: Document ya iski retained images verify nahi ho sakin. Original record rakhein aur refresh karne ke baad phir se koshish karein.
hinglish.documents.error.unavailable: Is server par branding uplabdha nahi hai. Update taiyar hone ke baad refresh karein.
hinglish.documents.error.update: Teen document layouts preview ya export karne ke liye is app build ko update karein.
hinglish.documents.error.render: Document ko surakshit roop se taiyar nahi kiya ja saka. Phir se koshish karein; koi clipped document export nahi hua.
hinglish.documents.error.scope: Dukaan ya sign-in kiya gaya account badal gaya hai. Sahi dukaan mein document ko phir se kholein.
hinglish.documents.error.failed: Action confirm nahi ho saka. Save ki gayi profile ya document check karein aur phir se koshish karein.
hinglish.documents.activity: Nayi bills ke liye {{layout}} branding save ho gayi
hinglish.documents.pending_sync: Original branding save hai. Bill ki saved request sync hone ke baad use kholen ya export karein.
hinglish.pos_settings.preferences_help: Badlav karne ke liye section kholein. Apne badlav neeche save karein.
hinglish.opening.title: Opening balances & migration
hinglish.opening.help: Apna purana stock aur pending balances Samaan Bol mein laayein. Owner ke confirm karne se pehle har change ko review karein.
hinglish.opening.cutover: Kisi date se opening balances laayein
hinglish.opening.cutover_help: Aisi dukaan ke liye jahan yahan koi sale, khareed ya stock activity nahi hui hai. Indian Standard Time ke hisaab se kisi purani date ke end ki closing position ka istemal karein; agle din se nayi activity shuru karein.
hinglish.opening.current_help: Active dukaan ke liye. Current records ke saath compare karein aur sirf difference add karein. Purane bills, payments aur costs traceable rahenge.
hinglish.opening.optional: Yeh step optional hai. Aap Settings → Data → Opening balances & migration se wapas aa sakte hain.
hinglish.opening.no_saved: Abhi tak koi saved setup nahi hai.
hinglish.opening.no_history: Abhi tak koi opening entry record nahi hui hai.
hinglish.opening.supplier_help: Ye Samaan Bol se pehle ke brought forward balances hain. Supplier purchase invoices alag rahenge. Opening dues ke against payments is history mein retain kiye jaate hain.
hinglish.opening.skip: Naya shuru karein — opening balances skip karein
hinglish.opening.no_results: Koi match nahi mila. Unhe add karne ke liye purane products ya contacts import karein.
hinglish.opening.existing: Opening balance pehle se maujood hai
hinglish.opening.existing_mode: Ek opening record pehle se maujood hai. Yeh setup ab current position ko compare karta hai; correction ka reason add karein.
hinglish.opening.cost: Add kiye gaye unit ki cost (optional)
hinglish.opening.cost_help: Sirf is setup dwara add kiye gaye stock ke liye istemal hota hai. Agar pata na ho toh blank chhodein. Purane batch aur bik chuke items ki costs preserve rahengi.
hinglish.opening.stock_help: Total physical stock enter karein, add karne wali quantity nahi. Review recorded stock se hua change dikhata hai. Ek setup mein 500 products tak import karein.
hinglish.opening.direction.customer.shop_owes: Hum customer ko bakaya dete hain
hinglish.opening.direction.supplier.shop_owes: Hum supplier ko bakaya dete hain
hinglish.opening.correction_help: Original opening amount ko theek karein. Baad ki payments record rahengi aur corrected balance ko kam karengi. Stock corrections maujooda physical count ka istemal karti hain.
hinglish.opening.cash_help: Starting position par optional cash on hand. Yeh seed future cashbook ke liye rakha jata hai; yeh aaj koi sales, income ya payment nahi banata.
hinglish.opening.saved: Draft save ho gaya. Koi opening change apply nahi hua hai.
hinglish.opening.owner_help: Ek manager yeh draft taiyar kar sakta hai. Shop owner se kahein ki Saved setups kholein, ise review karein aur online confirm karein.
hinglish.opening.confirm_help: Jab tak yeh setup poora na ho jaye, har counter par billing aur stock changes ko pause karein. Saved entries traceable rahti hain; corrections nayi entries ke roop mein record hoti hain.
hinglish.opening.work_check: Maine unlisted devices sahit har counter ko sync aur pause kar diya hai, aur sabhi pending bills, stock changes aur recovery ka kaam nipta liya hai.
hinglish.opening.overlap_check: Maine source date aur amounts check kar liye hain: yahan pehle se record ki gayi transactions ko dobara nahi gina gaya hai.
hinglish.opening.pending_help: Response beech mein ruk gaya tha. Aage badhne se pehle iska exact saved result check karein. Absent confirm ki gayi request close ho chuki hai, isliye late retry ise apply nahi kar sakti.
hinglish.opening.closed: Request record nahi hui aur ab close ho chuki hai. Aage badhne se pehle review refresh karein.
hinglish.opening.recovered: Saved result recover ho gaya hai. Baki entries review karein.
hinglish.opening.skipped: Opening setup skip ho gaya. Aap Settings se wapas aa sakte hain.
hinglish.opening.total.unknownCostRows: Agyaat cost ke saath add kiye gaye products
hinglish.opening.receive_supplier: Supplier se mili rakam record karein
hinglish.opening.legacy_help: Yeh balance pehle ke import se aaya hai. Yahan payment record karne se pehle ise traceable opening setup mein daalne ke liye ek current correction review karein.
hinglish.opening.loading: Opening setup load ho raha hai…
hinglish.opening.import_staged: Migration import: Abhi product ya contact details save karein. Opening stock aur balances owner ke review ke liye setup mein staged hain; yeh import unhe apply nahi karega.
hinglish.opening.import_confirm: Kya in details ko save karke review ke liye opening values stage ki jayein? Abhi koi opening stock ya balance record nahi hoga.
hinglish.opening.issue.reference: Confirm karne se pehle source ya reference add karein.
hinglish.opening.issue.empty: Kam se kam ek opening position add karein.
hinglish.opening.issue.historical: Is dukan mein activity hai. Current comparison par switch karein aur fark ko milayein (reconcile).
hinglish.opening.issue.target: Yeh product ya party uplabdha nahi hai. Setup refresh karein.
hinglish.opening.issue.exists: Ek opening record pehle se maujood hai. Ise correction ke roop mein mark karein aur ek wajah add karein.
hinglish.opening.issue.reason: Is row ke liye correction ki wajah add karein.
hinglish.opening.issue.correction_current: Corrections ke liye current comparison zaroori hai.
hinglish.opening.issue.number: Supported range ke andar ek sahi amount ya quantity dalein.
hinglish.opening.issue.stock_mismatch: Stock aur batches match nahi kar rahe hain. Aage badhne se pehle stock recovery suljhayein.
hinglish.opening.issue.ledger_mismatch: Customer balance aur ledger match nahi kar rahe hain. Aage badhne se pehle recovery suljhayein.
hinglish.opening.issue.unknown_cost: Add kiye gaye stock ki cost agyaat hai; yeh agyaat hi rahegi.
hinglish.opening.issue.stock_current: Daala gaya stock abhi gine gaye kul stock ke barabar hai. Sirf fark ko add ya hataya jayega.
hinglish.opening.error.invalid: Amounts, tareekhein aur select ki gayi rows check karein.
hinglish.opening.error.not_allowed: Sirf owners aur managers hi setup taiyar kar sakte hain. Ise sirf owner hi online record kar sakta hai.
hinglish.opening.error.not_found: Yeh setup ya item ab uplabdha nahi hai.
hinglish.opening.error.stale: Review ke baad se records badal gaye hain. Refresh karein aur dobara review karein.
hinglish.opening.error.resolve: Aage badhne se pehle review issues suljhayein aur save kiya hua result check karein.
hinglish.opening.error.reference: Koi source ya reference add karein.
hinglish.opening.error.empty: Kam se kam ek opening position add karein.
hinglish.opening.error.unavailable: Opening setup abhi thodi der ke liye uplabdha nahi hai. Thodi der mein phir se try karein.
hinglish.opening.error.scope: Account ya dukan badal gayi hai. Sahi dukan mein is setup ko phir se kholein.
hinglish.opening.error.pending: Aage badhne se pehle pending kaam ko sync ya resolve karein. Agar koi opening request dikh rahi hai toh aakhri save ki gayi request check karein.
hinglish.opening.error.conflict: Save kiye gaye records match nahi kar rahe hain. Refresh karein aur review karein; ek hi payment ko dobara enter na karein.
hinglish.opening.error.already_started: Kuch entries pehle se hi record ho chuki hain. Save kiye gaye setup ko hi aage badhayein; poori ho chuki rows ko badla nahi ja sakta.
hinglish.opening.error.historical: Is dukan mein activity hai. Current comparison ka istemal karein.
hinglish.opening.error.settlement: Payment ki date aur amount check karein. Yeh bache hue opening balance se zyada nahi ho sakta.
hinglish.opening.error.premium: Customer credit balance ke liye Premium chahiye. Stock aur supplier setup abhi bhi uplabdha hain.
hinglish.opening.error.storage: Save ki gayi request ko verify nahi kiya ja saka. Is device ka data sambhal kar rakhein aur aage badhne se pehle recovery check karein.
hinglish.opening.error.closed: Yeh request bina record kiye band kar di gayi thi. Surakshit roop se aage badhne ke liye review ko refresh karein.
hinglish.opening.error.offline: Opening positions ko save ya confirm karne ke liye internet se connect karein.
hinglish.opening.error.failed: Setup poora nahi ho saka. Save kiya gaya result check karein, phir refresh karein aur review karein.
hinglish.imports.error.opening_limit: Har opening setup mein zyada se zyada 500 non-skipped rows ka istemal karein.
hinglish.opening.total_help: Total aapke source se opening amount dikhata hai. Before → after waali rows mein pehle se record kiye gaye transactions aur payments shaamil hain.
hinglish.po.title: Purchase orders
hinglish.po.intro: Supplier se order karein, phir har delivery receive karein. Orders se stock add nahi hota aur supplier ka bakaya record nahi hota. Jab invoice aaye toh Record supplier invoice ka istemal karein.
hinglish.po.not_invoice: Purchase order — supplier invoice nahi hai
hinglish.po.search: Suppliers, buy-list items ya products search karein
hinglish.po.available: {{qty}} order karne ke liye bacha hai
hinglish.po.refine_search: Aur results uplabdha hain. List ko chhota karne ke liye naam se search karein.
hinglish.po.draft_help: Ek supplier ke liye ek order save karein. Quantity har product ke base unit mein hoti hai; packs apne aap convert nahi hote. Save karne aur issue karne se buy-list items stocked mark nahi hote.
hinglish.po.line_summary: Order kiya gaya {{ordered}} · Receive hua {{received}} · Bacha {{remaining}} {{unit}}
hinglish.po.issue_review: Maine supplier, quantity, units aur estimated price check kar liya hai.
hinglish.po.share_help: Share taiyar hai. Isse supplier ko delivery ya acceptance confirm nahi hota.
hinglish.po.share_cancelled: Sharing cancel ho gayi ya uplabdha nahi thi. Order save ho gaya hai; aap dobara try kar sakte hain.
hinglish.po.receipt_help: Sirf abhi accept ki gayi quantity dalein. Har accept kiye gaye item ke liye tax sahit unit cost confirm karein. Invoice record karte samay ise theek kiya ja sakta hai. Reject kiye gaye maal se stock mein entry nahi hoti aur ve replacement ke liye bakaya rehte hain.
hinglish.po.map_help: Is item ko accept karne se pehle usi base unit wala active stock product chunein. Agar product bana rahe hain, toh opening stock zero chhod dein.
hinglish.po.cost: Tax sahit confirm ki gayi receipt unit cost (₹)
hinglish.po.reject_reason: Reject karne ka reason (reject hone par zaroori hai)
hinglish.po.receipt_review: Maine accepted quantity, product match aur receipt cost check kar liya hai. Sirf accepted maal se hi stock badhega.
hinglish.po.close_help: Outstanding quantity cancel kar dein. Jo maal pehle hi receive ho chuka hai wo stock mein rahega aur receipt history bachi rahegi.
hinglish.po.empty: Abhi tak koi purchase order nahi hai. Shuru karne ke liye buy-list items ya products chunein.
hinglish.po.online_role: Purchase orders ke liye online connection aur owner ya manager access chahiye.
hinglish.po.storage: Bacha hua kaam load nahi ho paya. Device storage check karke dobara try karein.
hinglish.po.pending: Yeh request is device par save hai. Koi aur kaam shuru karne se pehle ise check karein ya dobara try karein; dobara try karne par wahi request istemal hogi.
hinglish.po.retry_saved: Save ki hui request check / dobara try karein
hinglish.po.buy_list_help: Supplier order ke liye buy-list items chunein. Quantity ko sync mein rakhne ke liye us order ke hisab se ordered items receive karein.
hinglish.po.invoice_help: Yeh maal pehle se hi stock mein hai. Receipt quantity aur stock links fix hain; neeche supplier invoice ke daam aur tax details check karein. Invoice record karne se stock dobara nahi badhega.
hinglish.po.invoice_unavailable: Receipt uplabdha nahi hai ya pehle hi invoice ho chuki hai. Iske linked invoice ko check karne ke liye order kholein.
hinglish.po.status.closed: Closed · baki cancel kar diya gaya
hinglish.po.error.invalid: Supplier, date aur order details check karein.
hinglish.po.error.quantity: Valid quantity dalein jisme teen decimal place tak ho aur daam do tak ho.
hinglish.po.error.supplier: Is dukan ke liye kisi save kiye hue supplier ko chunein.
hinglish.po.error.product: Ek active stock product chunein jiska base unit same ho.
hinglish.po.error.buy_list: Ek buy-list item badal gaya hai ya ab pending nahi hai. Order ko refresh karein.
hinglish.po.error.request_conflict: Yeh save ki gayi request record ki gayi request se alag hai. Isse save rakhein aur aage badhne se pehle order check karein.
hinglish.po.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner ya manager hi purchase order manage kar sakte hain.
hinglish.po.error.not_found: Yeh purchase order ya receipt nahi mila.
hinglish.po.error.stale: Order doosre device par badal gaya hai. Latest version load ho gaya hai; aage badhne se pehle ise check karein.
hinglish.po.error.state: Yeh action current order state ke liye available nahi hai.
hinglish.po.error.allocated: Kuch buy-list quantities pehle se hi doosre order par hain. Bachi hui demand ko check karein.
hinglish.po.error.remaining: Accepted aur rejected quantities outstanding quantity se zyada nahi ho sakti.
hinglish.po.error.reason: Rejected goods ke liye ek reason daalein.
hinglish.po.error.expiry: Ek valid expiry date chunein jo aaj ya uske baad ki ho.
hinglish.po.error.unavailable: Purchase orders thodi der ke liye unavailable hain. Service update hone ke baad retry karein.
hinglish.po.error.failed: Yeh action complete nahi ho saka. Retry karne se pehle save ki gayi request check karein.
hinglish.po.error.storage: Is device par save kiya hua kaam verify nahi ho saka. Aage badhne se pehle device storage check karein.
hinglish.estimates.title: Quotations / estimates
hinglish.estimates.intro: Estimate taiyaar karein, customer ke saath share karein, aur phir tay kiye gaye items ko checkout mein laayein. Save ya share karne se stock, paise ya bill number nahi badalte.
hinglish.estimates.share_disclaimer: Price aur tax sirf estimate hain. Koi stock reserve nahi hota aur koi payment record nahi hoti. Final stock, tax aur rounding checkout par check kiye jaate hain.
hinglish.estimates.cart_unchanged: Jab aap yeh estimate taiyaar kar rahe hon, tab counter cart vaisa hi rehta hai. Issue karne se pehle totals dekhne ke liye draft save karein.
hinglish.estimates.more_products: Aur products dhoondhne ke liye naam se search karein.
hinglish.estimates.save_draft: Draft save karein aur preview dekhein
hinglish.estimates.issue_review: Maine items, base units, prices, discounts, customer aur validity check kar li hai.
hinglish.estimates.share_prepared: Taiyaar kiya hua share ho gaya. Isse customer ka acceptance record nahi hota.
hinglish.estimates.share_cancelled: Sharing cancel ho gayi ya uplabdha nahi thi. Estimate save ho gaya hai.
hinglish.estimates.refresh: Stock aur price checks refresh karein
hinglish.estimates.convert_help: Bill banane se tay kiye gaye items ke saath normal checkout khulta hai. Bill poora karne se pehle availability, current tax, rounding aur payment check kar lein.
hinglish.estimates.intent_help: Yeh checkout apne original account aur installation ke liye reserve hai. Agar beech mein ruk gaya tha toh wahin se resume karein. Ek baar bill taiyaari shuru ho jaye, toh recovery ke liye save ki gayi request sambhaal kar rakhein.
hinglish.estimates.replace_cart: Current unsubmitted counter cart ko is estimate se replace karein.
hinglish.estimates.release_reason: Checkout taiyaari cancel karne ka kaaran
hinglish.estimates.open_bill: Convert kiye gaye bill ko kholein
hinglish.estimates.empty: Abhi koi estimate nahi hai. Products se ek banayein ya counter cart ko estimate ke roop mein save karein.
hinglish.estimates.online: Estimates ke liye online connection aur selling access ki zaroorat hoti hai.
hinglish.estimates.pending: Yeh action is device par save ho gaya hai. Koi aur action shuru karne se pehle ise check karein ya phir se try karein.
hinglish.estimates.retry: Save kiye gaye action ko check / retry karein
hinglish.estimates.save_cart: Cart ko estimate ke roop mein save karein
hinglish.estimates.checkout_review: Maine estimate, tay kiye gaye daam aur maujooda stock, tax aur final total ko check kar liya hai.
hinglish.estimates.checkout_help: Estimate ke daam aur quantity wahi rahenge. Final tax aur rounding yahan dikhayi jayegi. Is bill ko online poora karein; beech mein chhodi gayi bill tab tak pending rahegi jab tak server ise confirm na kar de.
hinglish.estimates.release_help: Bill shuru karne se pehle estimate se taiyari radd karein. Shuru kiye gaye checkout ko uske original installation par hi recover karna hoga.
hinglish.estimates.unsupported: Estimate banane se pehle custom items ko products ke roop mein save karein. Special RSP/package tax lines ke liye unke maujooda selling review ki zaroorat hoti hai aur unhe abhi estimate ke roop mein save nahi kiya ja sakta.
hinglish.estimates.different_cart: Cart badalne se pehle doosre estimate checkout ko poora karein ya radd karein.
hinglish.estimates.resume_pending: Save kiye gaye estimate checkout ko retry karein
hinglish.estimates.status.revised: Revision se replace kar diya gaya
hinglish.estimates.status.expired: Expire ho gaya — billing se pehle revise karein
hinglish.estimates.event.share: Taiyar kiya hua share kiya gaya
hinglish.estimates.event.accept: Customer ka acceptance record kar liya gaya
hinglish.estimates.event.release: Checkout ki taiyari radd kar di gayi
hinglish.estimates.event.started: Bill banana shuru ho gaya hai
hinglish.estimates.change.price: {{name}}: tay ₹{{agreed}}; abhi ka catalogue ₹{{current}}. Tay ki gayi keemat wahi rahegi.
hinglish.estimates.change.name: {{name}} ka naam ab catalogue mein {{current}} ho gaya hai.
hinglish.estimates.change.stock: {{name}}: {{agreed}} chahiye, abhi {{current}} uplabdha hai. Bill banane se pehle stock bhar lein.
hinglish.estimates.change.tax_changed: {{name}}: tax setup badal gaya hai. Bill banane se pehle ise check karein aur nayi estimate nikalein.
hinglish.estimates.change.product_changed: {{name}} archive ho gaya hai, missing hai ya koi alag unit use kar raha hai. Estimate ko revise karein.
hinglish.estimates.change.mrp: {{name}}: tay ki gayi keemat abhi ke MRP se zyada hai. Estimate ko revise karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.invalid: Estimate ki details aur validity date check karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.amount: Sahi keematein aur discount daalein (do decimal place tak), quantity teen tak, aur keematein MRP ke andar rakhein.
hinglish.estimates.error.phone: Ek sahi Indian mobile number daalein.
hinglish.estimates.error.customer: Bill banane se pehle estimate ka customer check karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.products: Matching base unit wale active save kiye gaye products chunein. Har product ko sirf ek baar jodein.
hinglish.estimates.error.not_allowed: Aapke paas is estimate ko dekhne ki permission nahi hai.
hinglish.estimates.error.conflict: Yeh save ki gayi request record ki gayi action se alag hai. Ise save rakhein aur estimate check karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.stale: Estimate badal gaya hai. Latest version load ho gaya hai; aage badhne se pehle ise check karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.state: Yeh action is estimate ki current state ke liye uplabdha nahi hai.
hinglish.estimates.error.tax: Issue karne se pehle tax details review karein. Listed products ya shop setup check karke estimate dobara check karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.expired: Yeh estimate expire ho gaya hai ya accept nahi hua hai. Bill banane se pehle ek nayi estimate banayein.
hinglish.estimates.error.reason: Acceptance ya revision ka reference daalein.
hinglish.estimates.error.changed: Items, tax, keematein ya discount accept ki gayi estimate se alag hain. Bill banane se pehle revision check karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.in_progress: Is estimate mein pehle se hi reserved ya shuru kiya gaya checkout hai. Ise original installation par resume karein; doosra bill na banayein.
hinglish.estimates.error.stock: Stock ya product details badal gayi hain. Bill banane se pehle refresh karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.unavailable: Estimate abhi kuch der ke liye uplabdha nahi hain. Service update hone ke baad retry karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.storage: Is device par save kiya gaya kaam verify nahi ho saka. Storage check karein aur is screen ko dobara kholein.
hinglish.estimates.error.checkout_pending: Cart ko nayi estimate se replace karne se pehle save kiye gaye bill ko recover karna zaroori hai.
hinglish.estimates.error.cart_changed: Counter cart badal gaya hai. Iske items ko replace karne se pehle ise check karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.confirmation_pending: Bill save ho gaya hai lekin server ne ise confirm nahi kiya hai. Is installation par save kiye gaye checkout ko retry karein.
hinglish.estimates.error.failed: Yeh action poora nahi ho saka. Koi bhi save ki gayi request rakhein aur connection check karne ke baad retry karein.
hinglish.cashbook.title: Kharch aur cashbook
hinglish.cashbook.intro: Dukaan ke kharchon ka track rakhein aur till mein rakhe gaye asli paison ko mila lein. Cash aur bina cash wale payments alag-alag dikhaye jaate hain.
hinglish.cashbook.setup_help: Chune gaye din ke shuru mein maujood cash ko confirm karein. Us samay se record kiye gaye maujooda payments ek baar shamil kiye jayenge. Pehle ke transactions is cashbook se bahar rahenge.
hinglish.cashbook.opening_suggestion: Brought-forward cash: ₹{{amount}} on {{date}}. Bilkul sahi retained starting time ka use kiya gaya hai.
hinglish.cashbook.manual_opening: Ek reviewed opening balance enter karein
hinglish.cashbook.setup_review: Maine starting cash, date aur historical payment coverage ko check kar liya hai.
hinglish.cashbook.owner_setup: Is cashbook ko use karne se pehle owner ko starting position confirm karni hogi.
hinglish.cashbook.coverage_help: {{date}} se record kiye gaye paison ke movements shamil hain. Pehle ki activity ko bahar rakha gaya hai. Yeh ek expected till balance hai, bank balance nahi.
hinglish.cashbook.opening_changed: Is cashbook ke shuru hone ke baad brought-forward cash entry badal gayi. Iski retained opening nahi badli hai. Difference ko review karein aur agar zaroorat ho toh ek reasoned cash adjustment record karein.
hinglish.cashbook.status.needs_review: Close hone ke baad badla gaya — review zaroori hai
hinglish.cashbook.late_help: Ek late entry ya pehle ke correction ne is din ko badal diya hai. Original count aur close ko retain kiya gaya hai. Isse dobara close karne se pehle din ko reopen karein aur review karein.
hinglish.cashbook.negative: Expected cash zero se neeche hai. Ginti karne se pehle opening, missing receipts aur recorded payments check karein.
hinglish.cashbook.no_events: Is date ke liye koi recorded money movements nahi hain.
hinglish.cashbook.showing: Showing {{n}} of {{total}} movements. Totals mein har movement shamil hai.
hinglish.cashbook.expense_paid: Payment pehle hi ho chuka hai
hinglish.cashbook.expense_paid_help: Bina payment wale aur future ki tareekh wale kharche cash ko nahi badalte. Paise asal mein transfer hone ke baad hi payment record karein.
hinglish.cashbook.empty_expenses: Abhi tak koi kharcha nahi. Shuruat karne ke liye kiraya, mazdoori, transport ya petty cash record karein.
hinglish.cashbook.expense_status.part_paid: Aanshik roop se bhugtan kiya gaya
hinglish.cashbook.scheduled: Future ka kharcha — koi payment record nahi ki gayi
hinglish.cashbook.reverse_help: Record ki gayi payment ko reverse karne se cashbook theek ho jati hai aur kharche ka balance phir se khul jata hai. Isse paise transfer nahi hote. Saboot aur wajah apne paas rakhein.
hinglish.cashbook.reverse_payment: Record ki gayi payment ko reverse karein
hinglish.cashbook.cancel_expense: Bina payment wale kharche ko cancel karein
hinglish.cashbook.cancel_help: Paid expense ko tabhi cancel kiya ja sakta hai jab uski payments sahi ho jayein. Original records history mein rahenge.
hinglish.cashbook.count_help: Physical count ko expected cash ke saath compare karein. Difference hamesha ek discrepancy hi rehti hai; counting se koi expense, income ya adjustment nahi banta.
hinglish.cashbook.count_review: Maine saare counters aur pending bills check kar liye hain aur is cash count ko review kar liya hai.
hinglish.cashbook.cash_help: Sales aur expenses se alag, cash introduce, withdraw ya reviewed adjustment ko record karein. Yeh evidence record karta hai; isse bahar ka paisa move nahi hota.
hinglish.cashbook.export_help: Export mein opening, totals, count aur source movements ka yeh version retain hota hai. Baad ke changes ke liye naya export karna hoga.
hinglish.cashbook.pending: Yeh action is device par retain ho gaya hai. Doosra action shuru karne se pehle ise check karein ya retry karein.
hinglish.cashbook.online: Expenses aur cashbook ke liye online owner ya manager session chahiye.
hinglish.cashbook.error.invalid: Fields check karo aur dobara try karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.amount: Ek valid amount daalo, jisme zyada se zyada do decimal place hon.
hinglish.cashbook.error.date: Ek valid date chuno. Payment future ki date ki nahi ho sakti.
hinglish.cashbook.error.reason: Save karne se pehle ek clear reference ya reason add karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.method: Cash, UPI, card ya bank chuno.
hinglish.cashbook.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner aur manager hi expenses aur cashbook access kar sakte hain.
hinglish.cashbook.error.owner: Sirf owner hi opening cash, cash adjustment ya day close confirm kar sakta hai.
hinglish.cashbook.error.setup: Owner se kaho ki pehle is cashbook ko start kare.
hinglish.cashbook.error.before_start: Yeh date cashbook start hone se pehle ki hai. Agar zaroorat ho toh reviewed current-period correction use karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.coverage: Is period ki kuch payments mein incomplete method proof hai. Source records check karo ya baad ka koi verified opening point chuno.
hinglish.cashbook.error.too_many: Is period mein ek export ya setup ke liye bahut zyada source records hain. Baad ka koi reviewed starting point chuno ya support se contact karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.conflict: Saved request kisi recorded action se conflict kar rahi hai. Saved request ko rakho aur aage badhne se pehle ise review karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.stale: Records change ho gaye hain. Save karne se pehle latest values ko refresh aur review karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.closed: Yeh din close ho chuka hai. Payment add karne ya correct karne se pehle owner se ise dobara kholne (reopen) ko kaho.
hinglish.cashbook.error.reopen: Dobara close karne se pehle review ke liye is changed close ko dobara kholo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.review: Confirm karo ki aapne starting position ya cash count review kar liya hai.
hinglish.cashbook.error.already_started: Is cashbook mein pehle se hi ek retained starting position hai. Aage badhne ke liye refresh karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.category: Ek valid category ya koi alag custom category name chuno.
hinglish.cashbook.error.overpay: Payment bache hue expense balance se zyada hai.
hinglish.cashbook.error.not_found: Yeh expense current shop mein nahi mila.
hinglish.cashbook.error.cancelled: Yeh expense pehle hi cancel ho chuka hai.
hinglish.cashbook.error.reversed: Is payment ko pehle hi correct ya reverse kiya ja chuka hai.
hinglish.cashbook.error.paid_cancel: Is expense ko cancel karne se pehle recorded payments ko correct karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.unavailable: Cashbook abhi is server par available nahi hai. Koi bhi saved request rakho aur update ke baad dobara try karo.
hinglish.cashbook.error.storage: Yeh action is device par safely save nahi ho paya. Storage check karo aur retry karo; duplicate mat banao.
hinglish.cashbook.error.load: Cashbook load nahi ho saki. Connection check karke phir koshish karein.
hinglish.cashbook.error.failed: Is action ko confirm nahi kiya ja saka. Saved request rakho aur connection check karne ke baad retry karo.
hinglish.credit.title: Statements & credit controls
hinglish.credit.intro: Date ke saath ek statement share karein, unpaid items check karein aur clear credit terms fix karein. Payments bill ko tabhi change karti hain jab unhe uske saath allocate kar diya jata hai.
hinglish.credit.limit: Credit limit (₹; blank matlab koi limit set nahi hai)
hinglish.credit.term_days: Default payment term (din; blank matlab koi due date nahi hai)
hinglish.credit.strict: Limit se upar ke credit ko block karein
hinglish.credit.allow_override: Reason ke saath owner/manager exceptions allow karein
hinglish.credit.policy_help: Changes naye credit par apply hote hain. Purani due dates aur bills ki retained terms waisi hi rahengi. Shop-wide restrictions customer terms par bhi apply hote hain.
hinglish.credit.reset_policy: Is customer ke liye shop defaults use karein
hinglish.credit.overdue: Due date paar kar chuka udhaar
hinglish.credit.unknown_due: Due date ke bina unpaid amount
hinglish.credit.unassigned_help: Ek payment customer balance ko kam kar sakti hai jabki woh abhi bill allocation ka intezaar kar rahi ho. Kisi specific bill ko paid treat karne se pehle ise review kar lein.
hinglish.credit.review_collections: Existing payments aur bills review karein
hinglish.credit.we_owe: Hum customer ke ₹{{amount}} ke karzdaar hain
hinglish.credit.no_statements: Abhi tak koi saved statements nahi hain.
hinglish.credit.export_help: Snapshot banate samay customer, period, ledger aur language retain rehti hai. Sharing se export open hota hai; yeh delivery proof nahi karta.
hinglish.credit.obligations_now: Unpaid items export ke samay ki position dikhate hain, jo statement period se alag hoti hai.
hinglish.credit.no_obligations: Koi recorded credit obligation nahi hai.
hinglish.credit.due_help: Yeh is obligation ke liye payment agreement ko update karta hai aur iski history ko retain karta hai. Yeh original invoice ya customer balance ko nahi badalta.
hinglish.credit.allocate: Opening debt par existing payment apply karein
hinglish.credit.allocation_help: Yeh pehle se record kiye gaye paise ko brought-forward debt se link karta hai. Yeh dobara paise collect nahi karta ya customer balance nahi badalta.
hinglish.credit.reversal_help: Sirf allocation link ko reverse karein. Record kiya gaya payment aur customer balance waisa hi rahega.
hinglish.credit.checkout_intro: Is bill ko record karne se pehle balance, proposed naya credit aur due date review karein. Cash, UPI aur card portions naye credit se exclude kiye gaye hain.
hinglish.credit.warning.limit: Resulting exposure credit limit se zyada hai.
hinglish.credit.warning.overdue: Is customer ke kuch overdue unpaid items hain.
hinglish.credit.warning.unassigned: Kuch payments ko abhi allocation review ki zaroorat hai.
hinglish.credit.warning.unknown: Kuch unpaid items ki koi known due date nahi hai.
hinglish.credit.warning.disabled: Dukaan ki policy ke hisaab se naya credit disabled hai.
hinglish.credit.blocked: Cash, UPI ya card se payment collect karein, ya credit terms review karein.
hinglish.credit.ack: Maine current balance, warnings aur due date review kar li hai.
hinglish.credit.online: Naya credit review aur record karne ke liye internet connect karein.
hinglish.credit.choose_customer: Credit review karne ke liye koi saved customer chunein, ya naye customer ki entry poori karein.
hinglish.credit.checking: Current credit check kar rahe hain…
hinglish.credit.pending: Ek saved action ko abhi bhi confirmation chahiye. Doosra action shuru karne se pehle ise check kar lein.
hinglish.credit.unreconciled_help: Saved customer balance aur available ledger mein fark hai. Is difference ki koi transaction date nahi hai. Purane statement par bharosa karne se pehle opening balances check kar lein.
hinglish.credit.error.amount: Do decimal places tak ka valid amount daalein.
hinglish.credit.error.reason: Koi reason ya agreement reference daalein.
hinglish.credit.error.date: Valid dates chunein. Statement period 367 din tak ka ho sakta hai aur future mein end nahi ho sakta.
hinglish.credit.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner ya manager hi statements aur credit settings open kar sakte hain.
hinglish.credit.error.owner: Sirf owner hi shop-wide credit defaults change kar sakta hai.
hinglish.credit.error.not_found: Maanga gaya customer ya record available nahi hai.
hinglish.credit.error.conflict: Yeh saved request match nahi ho rahi. Aage badhne se pehle original action check kar lein.
hinglish.credit.error.blocked: Yeh bill allowed credit se zyada hai. Payment collect karein ya kisi authorized manager se ise review karwayein.
hinglish.credit.error.review: Current credit warnings check karein aur is bill ko record karne se pehle confirm karein.
hinglish.credit.error.allocation: Yeh amount ab allocation ke liye uplabdha nahi hai. Payments aur obligations refresh karein.
hinglish.credit.error.too_many: Is view ya statement ke liye bahut saare records hain. Kam samay ka period chunein ya retained ledger check karein.
hinglish.credit.error.storage: Yeh action is device par safely save nahi ho saka. Storage check karein aur phir try karein.
hinglish.credit.error.unavailable: Credit records abhi temporarily uplabdha nahi hain. Connection check karein aur retry karein.
hinglish.credit.error.failed: Action confirm nahi ho saka. Retry karne se pehle saved request check karein.
hinglish.credit.no_history: Abhi tak koi changes record nahi hue hain.
hinglish.followups.title: Payment Follow-ups
hinglish.followups.intro: Due bills check karein, reminder taiyar karein aur contact history clear rakhein. Sirf record kiye gaye payments aur allocations hi payment status badalte hain.
hinglish.followups.search: Naam ya phone se search karein
hinglish.followups.empty: Is page par koi matching customer nahi hai.
hinglish.followups.scanned: Is page par {{count}} customer records review ho rahe hain.
hinglish.followups.unknown: Bina tay due date ke unpaid amount
hinglish.followups.scheduled: Aaj ke liye in-app reminder schedule hai
hinglish.followups.no_history: Abhi tak koi reminder ya contact notes nahi hain.
hinglish.followups.history_help: History records taiyar karna aur merchant ke actions. Yeh delivery ya payment confirm nahi karta.
hinglish.followups.select_help: Mention karne ke liye bills ya opening debt chunein. Allocation ka intezar kar rahe payments ko pehle review karna hoga.
hinglish.followups.preview_help: Composer kholne se pehle customer, phone, chune gaye bills, amount, language aur payment destination check karein. Kuch bhi automatically send nahi hota.
hinglish.followups.no_items: Tay due date ke saath koi unpaid obligation nahi hai.
hinglish.followups.choose_due: Due date set karein ya review karein
hinglish.followups.payment_notice: Ek UPI link configured shop destination kholta hai. Link kholne se payment verify nahi hota.
hinglish.followups.share_help: Composer kholein, phir review karein aur khud ko bhej dein. Agar WhatsApp available nahi hai, toh SMS chunein ya message copy karein.
hinglish.followups.sent_help: Ise khud bhejne ke baad hi mark karein. Yeh ek merchant record hai, delivery confirmation nahi.
hinglish.followups.settings_help: Shop ke restrictions har customer par laagu hote hain. Reminder ki language pehle customer preference, phir shop preference aur shop language ke hisaab se hoti hai. Hours Indian Standard Time (IST) mein hote hain.
hinglish.followups.hours_help: Inhi ghanton ke dauran reminders taiyaar kiye ja sakte hain. Din mein har customer ke liye ek reminder; aap doosre channel ke liye same preview dobara use kar sakte hain.
hinglish.followups.pending: Ek saved action ko confirmation ki zaroorat hai. Doosra action shuru karne se pehle ise check karein.
hinglish.followups.offline: Reminders refresh karne ya message taiyaar karne ke liye connect karein. Jab aap dobara connect karenge toh saved request check ki ja sakti hai.
hinglish.followups.copied: Reminder copy ho gaya. Share karne se pehle ise review karein.
hinglish.followups.no_contact: Abhi tak koi follow-up nahi hai.
hinglish.followups.task_help: Scheduled reminders is queue mein dikhte hain. Baahri WhatsApp ya SMS messages kabhi bhi apne aap nahi bheje jaate.
hinglish.followups.message: Namaste {{name}}, yeh {{shop}} hai. Aapke selected bills ke liye {{amount}} ki payment {{due}} tak tay ki gayi thi. Kripya payment karein ya review ke liye humse contact karein. {{link}} Dhanyawad.
hinglish.followups.event.settings: Reminder preferences update ho gayi hain
hinglish.followups.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner ya manager hi payment follow-ups use kar sakte hain.
hinglish.followups.error.owner: Sirf owner hi shop ke reminder defaults badal sakta hai.
hinglish.followups.error.not_found: Yeh customer ya reminder uplabdh nahi hai.
hinglish.followups.error.stale: Payment status ya contact details badal gaye hain. Refresh karein aur naya reminder taiyar karein.
hinglish.followups.error.settled: Is selection ke liye ab koi balance collect nahi karna hai. Customer records refresh karein.
hinglish.followups.error.allocation: Payments ya credits ko abhi bhi allocation review ki zaroorat hai. Payment maangne se pehle inhe check kar lein.
hinglish.followups.error.unknown: Reminder mein is obligation ko shaamil karne se pehle due date fix karein.
hinglish.followups.error.disabled: Is shop ya customer ke liye follow-ups band hain.
hinglish.followups.error.snoozed: Is customer ke liye follow-ups snooze par hain.
hinglish.followups.error.quiet: Yeh shop ke reminder hours ke bahar hai. Set kiye gaye hours ke dauran try karein.
hinglish.followups.error.cooldown: Aaj contact ke liye pehle hi ek follow-up taiyar kiya ja chuka hai. Iski history check karein ya current preview ko dobara use karein.
hinglish.followups.error.phone: Message taiyar karne se pehle customer ka valid mobile number daalein.
hinglish.followups.error.reason: Koi reason ya contact reference daalein.
hinglish.followups.error.date: Ek saal ke andar aage ki koi valid resume date chunein.
hinglish.followups.error.conflict: Yeh save kiya gaya request recorded action se match nahi karta. Review ke liye original request hi rakhein.
hinglish.followups.error.storage: Is device par action ko surakshit roop se save nahi kiya ja saka. Storage check karein aur dobara try karein.
hinglish.followups.error.unavailable: Follow-up records filhaal uplabdh nahi hain. Reconnect karne ke baad dobara try karein.
hinglish.followups.error.failed: Action confirm nahi ho saka. Dobara try karne se pehle save kiya gaya request check karein.
hinglish.counter.search_sales: Bill number, customer, phone, product ya note search karein
hinglish.counter.search_refunds: Original bill, customer, return reference ya reason search karein
hinglish.counter.ist_days: Dono dates shaamil hain, India Standard Time (IST) ka istemal ho raha hai.
hinglish.counter.discovery_help: Saved number, customer, product ya note se bill dhoondhein.
hinglish.counter.snapshot_help: Yeh list ek consistent page order rakhti hai. Nayi entries shaamil karne ke liye refresh karein.
hinglish.counter.no_bills: Koi bill in filters se match nahi karta.
hinglish.counter.sales_no_access: Aapka role in sales ko nahi dekh sakta.
hinglish.counter.refund_period_help: Returns usi date par dikhte hain jis din unhe process kiya gaya tha, original bill ki date se alag.
hinglish.counter.scanner_help: Scan karne se pehle is field par focus karein. Har code ke baad Enter dabane se ek scan judta hai; ek hi code ko dobara scan karna jaan-boojhkar kiya jata hai. Baaki jagah normal typing record nahi hoti.
hinglish.counter.scanner_invalid: Item add karne se pehle valid product code daalein.
hinglish.counter.scanner_add: Scan kiya hua code add karein
hinglish.counter.scanner_not_found: Is barcode se koi product match nahi ho raha. Ise add karne ke liye manager se kahein.
hinglish.counter.offline_scan_miss: Yeh barcode saved catalogue mein unique nahi hai. Ise dhoondhne ke liye connect karein.
hinglish.counter.camera_help: Camera ko kisi product ke barcode par point karein. Ek baar sahi scan hone ke baad reader band ho jayega.
hinglish.counter.camera_blocked: Camera access uplabdha nahi hai ya block hai. Iske bajaye keyboard / USB scanner field ka istemal karein.
hinglish.counter.camera_failed: Camera reader start nahi ho saka. Iske bajaye keyboard / USB scanner field ka istemal karein.
hinglish.counter.draft_saving: Is browser par draft save ho raha hai…
hinglish.counter.draft_saved: Is browser par draft save ho gaya
hinglish.counter.draft_error: Browser storage mein draft verify nahi ho saka. Is page ko khula rakhein aur charge karne se pehle storage check karein.
hinglish.counter.draft_changed: Yeh draft kisi aur tab mein badal gaya hai. Charge karne se pehle current cart check karein.
hinglish.counter.recovery_storage_error: Saved requests ko padha nahi ja saka. Doosra bill shuru karne se pehle browser storage check karein.
hinglish.counter.offline_status: Saved counter data istemal ho raha hai. Current server status uplabdha nahi hai.
hinglish.counter.guide_draft: Saved cart ek draft hai. Ismein koi issued bill number nahi hota aur yeh payment record nahi karta ya stock kam nahi karta.
hinglish.counter.guide_issued: Bill sirf locally tabhi issue hota hai jab iski poori raseed aur zaroori stock, tax, invoice authorization aur entitlement evidence verify hokar save ho jayein. Warna, draft rakhein aur dobara connect karein.
hinglish.counter.guide_unknown: Agar reply kho jata hai, toh outcome unconfirmed hai. Original saved request ko review ya retry karein; usi payment ke liye doosra bill na banayein.
hinglish.counter.guide_reconnect: Dobara connect hone par, original request check aur synchronize hoti hai. Ek hi baar baar koshish karne par duplicate recording rokne ke liye same identity ka istemal hota hai.
hinglish.counter.guide_scope: Saved records is signed-in account, shop aur browser ke hote hain. Naya device kisi doosre browser ke unsynchronized records recover nahi kar sakta.
hinglish.counter.guide_storage: Private browsing, cleared storage ya missing cached app ki wajah se offline reopening ruk sakti hai. Saved requests confirm hone tak is browser ka storage rakhein.
hinglish.counter.outcome_unknown: Connection toot gaya. Outcome confirm nahi hai. Saved request ko rakhein aur reconnect hone ke baad iski original identity ke saath retry karein.
hinglish.counter.print_failed: Print preview taiyar nahi ho saka. Bill ko khula rakhein aur dobara try karein.
hinglish.counter.error.counter_cursor: Saved page ab in filters se match nahi karta. Register ko pehle page se reload karein.
hinglish.counter.error.counter_invalid_filters: Search, payment method aur page filters check karein, phir try karein.
hinglish.counter.error.invalid_range: Sahi start aur end date chunein. End date start date ke barabar ya uske baad ki honi chahiye.
hinglish.counter.error.counter_not_allowed: Aapka current role yeh register nahi khol sakta.
hinglish.counter.refunds_no_access: Sirf owner aur manager hi refund register khol sakte hain.
hinglish.counter.no_refunds: In filters ke hisaab se koi return nahi mila.
hinglish.counter.error.counter_export_limit: 50,000 se zyada bills match kar rahe hain. Export karne se pehle time period kam karein ya search karein.
hinglish.counter.pending_outcomes: Review ya server confirmation ka intezaar kar rahe saved requests: {{n}}. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki payment ho gayi hai ya naya bill ban gaya hai.
hinglish.counter.legacy_print: Is bill ke saath koi saved branding nahi judi thi. Standard print mein dukan ki dikhne wali details ka istemal hota hai.
hinglish.counter.bill_connection: Is bill ko load karne ke liye connect karein. Saved requests isi browser ke recovery page par uplabdha rahenge.
hinglish.commerce.title: Online store aur orders
hinglish.commerce.intro: Apne public catalog, customer orders aur product QR codes ko manage karein. Sirf published stores hi customers ko dikhte hain.
hinglish.commerce.online_role: Online store manage karne ke liye owner ya manager ke taur par connect karein.
hinglish.commerce.draft_help: Har product ka ek stable QR link hota hai. Hidden products aur draft stores customers ke liye uplabdha nahi hote.
hinglish.commerce.config_policy: Cancellation, returns aur collection ki jankari
hinglish.commerce.config_upi: Pickup / delivery par shop UPI se payment karein
hinglish.commerce.payment_help: Order handover karte samay staff cash ya shop ki bank app check karta hai. UPI link, screenshot ya type kiya hua reference kabhi bhi apne aap payment confirm nahi karta.
hinglish.commerce.delivery_help: Delivery normal non-GST orders ke liye uplabdha hai. GST orders ke liye abhi sirf shop par pickup support hai. Delivery charges nahi jode jate.
hinglish.commerce.preview: Save kiye gaye customer details ka preview
hinglish.commerce.preview_help: Yeh preview save kiye gaye details aur is product page ko dikhata hai. Publish karne se pehle sabhi listed products check kar lein.
hinglish.commerce.publish_review: Maine save kiye gaye public details, listed products, prices aur cancellation ki jankari check kar li hai.
hinglish.commerce.issue_setup: Public naam, phone, pickup address aur cancellation ki jankari poori karein.
hinglish.commerce.issue_payment: Collection ke samay cash ya shop UPI offer karein.
hinglish.commerce.issue_upi: UPI offer karne se pehle Payments & bills mein ek valid shop UPI ID set karein.
hinglish.commerce.issue_delivery_tax: GST-registered shop ke liye delivery disable karein; pickup support hai.
hinglish.commerce.issue_listings: Kam se kam ek active, priced product list karein.
hinglish.commerce.search_products: Product khojein ya product ID paste karein
hinglish.commerce.listing_name: Customer ko dikhne wala product ka naam
hinglish.commerce.visible: Is product ko public mein list karein
hinglish.commerce.price_help: Prices aur units product record se aate hain. Inhe Products mein badlein.
hinglish.commerce.qr_help: QR is product page ko kholta hai. Ismein koi payment detail ya order tracking access nahi hai. 1024px PNG ko uske white border ke saath save/share karein.
hinglish.commerce.unsupported_product: Order karne se pehle ek active product, supported fixed price aur valid tax details set karein.
hinglish.commerce.no_products: Koi product nahi mila. Pehle apni inventory mein product add karein.
hinglish.commerce.reservation_until: Stock {{at}} tak hold par hai. Expire hone ke baad dobara check karein.
hinglish.commerce.reason: Customer ko dikhane wali rejection ya cancellation ki wajah
hinglish.commerce.bill_collect: Bill banayein aur payment collect karein
hinglish.commerce.bill_help: Saved order usi item aur total ke saath ek estimate kholta hai. Isse review karein aur Convert to bill ka istemal karein. Maujooda checkout mein cash ya shop UPI confirm karein. Payment se order fulfilled nahi hota. Payment ke baad returns ya refund ke liye bill ka istemal karein.
hinglish.commerce.no_orders: Abhi tak koi customer order nahi hai.
hinglish.commerce.pending: Is saved action ko abhi confirmation chahiye. Koi aur action shuru karne se pehle iski original request dobara try karein.
hinglish.commerce.payment_staff_confirmed: Staff dwara payment confirm ki gayi
hinglish.commerce.action_accepted: Accept karein aur stock reserve karein
hinglish.commerce.product_unavailable: Yeh product ya shop online uplabdha nahi hai. Shop se sampark karein ya baad mein try karein.
hinglish.commerce.fulfilment: Aap order kaise receive karna chahenge?
hinglish.commerce.email_help: Order place karne ke liye apna email verify karein. Is order ke liye aapka phone shop ke saath share kiya jata hai; yeh SMS se verify nahi hota.
hinglish.commerce.verify_email: Is order ke liye apna email verify karein
hinglish.commerce.email_code: Aapka Samaan Bol order verification code {{code}} hai. Ise kisi ke saath share na karein.
hinglish.commerce.email_expiry: Code 10 minute mein expire ho jayega. Agar aapne iski request nahi ki hai toh is email ko ignore karein.
hinglish.commerce.code_sent: Verification code bhej diya gaya hai. Apna email check karein.
hinglish.commerce.review_help: Jab shop accept karta hai toh keemtein, tax aur availability dobara check ki jati hain. Request koi bill ya payment nahi hai. Accept kiya gaya stock 48 ghante tak hold par rehta hai; expiry ke baad shop ko dobara check karna hoga.
hinglish.commerce.tax: Tax shaamil / total mein joda gaya
hinglish.commerce.request_review: Maine items, total, pickup/delivery details aur shop cancellation ki jankari review kar li hai.
hinglish.commerce.tracking_help: Is private tracking link ko apne paas rakhein. Jis kisi ke paas yeh link hoga, woh aapka order aur contact details dekh sakta hai. Koi automatic order notification nahi bheja jata.
hinglish.commerce.tracking_unavailable: Yeh private order link missing ya invalid hai. Poora save kiya hua link kholein.
hinglish.commerce.upi_help: Jab staff aapka order de, tab pay karein. Staff ko shop bank app mein receipt confirm karni hogi. Yeh link payment confirm nahi karta.
hinglish.commerce.staff_payment_help: Payment status sirf tab badalta hai jab staff bill ke zariye collection record kar le.
hinglish.commerce.bill_voided: Link kiya gaya bill cancel ho gaya hai. Shop se contact karein.
hinglish.commerce.order_privacy: Contact aur delivery details sirf shop aur aapke private tracking link wale logon ke saath share ki jati hain.
hinglish.commerce.stock_help: Availability sirf ek indication hai. Shop aapki request accept karte hi stock confirm aur reserve kar deta hai.
hinglish.commerce.saved_request: Saved order request confirmation ka wait kar rahi hai. Iske details badle bina ise retry karein.
hinglish.commerce.storage_help: Order request confirm hone tak yeh browser open rakhein. Agar storage available nahi hai, toh aapki request miss na ho iske liye ordering block kar di jati hai.
hinglish.commerce.error.invalid: Details check karein aur dobara try karein.
hinglish.commerce.error.not_found: Store, product ya order nahi mila.
hinglish.commerce.error.not_allowed: Sirf owner ya manager hi aisa kar sakte hain.
hinglish.commerce.error.unpublished: Yeh store ya product online available nahi hai.
hinglish.commerce.error.setup: Publish karne se pehle store setup poora karein aur products review karein.
hinglish.commerce.error.fulfilment: Dene wale pickup ya delivery option mein se chunein.

ta.imports.title: பொருட்களை இறக்குமதி செய்
ta.imports.help: Excel அல்லது CSV பட்டியலைக் கொண்டு வாருங்கள். சேமிக்கும் முன் சரிபார்க்கவும்.
ta.imports.template_help: வார்ப்புருவின் நெடுவரிசைப் பெயர்களைப் பயன்படுத்தவும். பார்கோடை உரையாக வைக்கவும். புதுப்பிப்பில் காலியான செல் பழைய மதிப்பைத் தக்கவைக்கும்.
ta.imports.stock_help: தொடக்க இருப்பு புதிய பொருட்களுக்கு மட்டும். உரிமையாளர் மட்டுமே இருப்பை இறக்குமதி செய்யலாம். பழைய இருப்பு மாறாது.
ta.imports.review_help: விலை, இருப்பு, பொருத்தங்களைச் சரிபார்க்கவும். தேவையற்ற வரிகளைத் தவிர்க்கவும் அல்லது கோப்பைத் திருத்தவும்.
ta.imports.mapping_help: ஒவ்வொரு புலத்தையும் கோப்பு நெடுவரிசையுடன் பொருத்தவும். காலியான வகைக்கு இயல்புநிலை பயன்படும்.
ta.imports.confirm: சரிபார்த்த மாற்றங்களைச் சேமிக்கவா? விலையும் புதிய இருப்பும் மீட்டெடுக்கக்கூடிய தொகுதிகளில் சேமிக்கப்படும்.
ta.imports.error.failed: செயலை முடிக்க முடியவில்லை. இறக்குமதி பாதுகாப்பாக உள்ளது. மீண்டும் முயலவும் அல்லது முடிவைப் பார்க்கவும்.
ta.imports.error.unavailable: இந்த சேவையகத்தில் இறக்குமதி இன்னும் இயங்கவில்லை. இருக்கும் பொருட்கள் பொருட்கள் பக்கத்தில் உள்ளன.
ta.imports.error.stale_review: சரிபார்த்த பின் பொருட்கள் மாறியுள்ளன. தொடரும் முன் மீண்டும் சரிபார்க்கவும்.
ta.imports.error.not_allowed: உரிமையாளர் அல்லது மேலாளர் மட்டுமே பொருட்களை இறக்குமதி செய்யலாம்.
ta.imports.error.invalid_file: கோப்பைப் படிக்க முடியவில்லை. மதிப்புகள் மட்டும் உள்ள நகலைச் சேமித்து முயலவும்.
ta.imports.error.too_large: கோப்பு வரம்பை மீறுகிறது. சிறிய கோப்புகளாகப் பிரிக்கவும்.
ta.imports.error.resolve_errors: சேமிக்கும் முன் சிக்கல் வரிகளைத் திருத்தவும் அல்லது தவிர்க்கவும்.
ta.imports.field.name: பொருளின் பெயர்
ta.imports.issue.values_only: சூத்திரம் அல்ல, உரை அல்லது மதிப்பைப் பயன்படுத்தவும். குறியீடுகளை உரை செல்களில் வைக்கவும்.
ta.imports.issue.identifier_invalid: பார்கோடு அல்லது குறியீடு மிக நீளமாக உள்ளது.
ta.imports.issue.existing_product: பொருள் ஏற்கனவே உள்ளது. தவிர்க்கவும் அல்லது புதுப்பித்தலைத் தேர்வு செய்யவும்.
ta.imports.issue.ambiguous_product: பல பொருட்கள் பொருந்துகின்றன. பார்கோடு அல்லது குறியீட்டைத் திருத்தவும்.
ta.imports.issue.archived_product: பொருள் காப்பகத்தில் உள்ளது. புதுப்பிக்கும் முன் மீட்டெடுக்கவும்.
ta.imports.issue.no_match: இருக்கும் பொருள் பொருந்தவில்லை. பார்கோடு, குறியீடு அல்லது பெயரைச் சரிபார்க்கவும்.
ta.imports.issue.duplicate_file: இந்த வரி கோப்பில் பொருளை அல்லது குறியீட்டை மீண்டும் கொண்டுள்ளது.
ta.imports.issue.category_invalid: கடைக்கான சரியான வகை மற்றும் துணைவகையைத் தேர்வு செய்யவும்.
ta.imports.issue.unit_invalid: kg, g, L, mL, piece, packet, dozen அல்லது crate பயன்படுத்தவும்.
ta.imports.issue.unit_change: இறக்குமதியில் இருக்கும் பொருளின் அலகை மாற்ற முடியாது.
ta.imports.issue.number_invalid: பூஜ்யம் அல்லது நேர்ம எண் கொடுக்கவும்; மீள் ஆர்டர் அளவு முழு எண்ணாக இருக்க வேண்டும்.
ta.imports.issue.owner_stock: உரிமையாளர் மட்டுமே தொடக்க இருப்பை இறக்குமதி செய்யலாம்.
ta.imports.issue.stock_update: தொடக்க இருப்பு பழைய இருப்பை மாற்ற முடியாது.
ta.imports.issue.unpriced: விற்பனை விலை இல்லை; விற்கும் முன் சேர்க்கவும்.
ta.imports.preview_notice: உள்ளூர் சோதனைக் கடை · நேரடித் தரவு இல்லை. இறக்குமதி சோதனைத் தரவை மட்டுமே மாற்றும்.

ta.catalog.l2.pain-cold: வலி, சளி, இருமல், ஆன்டாசிட், அலர்ஜி மருந்துகள்

ta.partiesImport.help: எக்செல் அல்லது CSV-ல இருந்து ஏற்கனவே இருக்கிற காண்டாக்ட்கள் மற்றும் அவங்களோட ஓப்பனிங் பேலன்ஸை கொண்டு வாங்க. சேவ் பண்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி ஒவ்வொரு வரிசையையும் செக் பண்ணிக்கோங்க.
ta.partiesImport.template_help: டெம்ப்ளேட் காலம்களின் பெயர்களைப் பயன்படுத்துங்க. போன் நம்பர்கள், GSTIN-கள் மற்றும் ஸ்டேட் கோடுகளை டெக்ஸ்ட்டாகவே வைங்க. காலியாக இருக்கிற அப்டேட் செல்கள் ஏற்கனவே இருக்கிற விவரங்களை அப்படியே வைக்கும்.
ta.partiesImport.supplier_required: ஏற்கனவே இருக்கிற சப்ளையர் டைரக்டரிக்கு சப்ளையர்களுக்கு ஒரு முகவரியும், ரெண்டு இலக்க ஸ்டேட் கோடும் தேவை. பதிவு செய்யப்படாத சப்ளையர்களுக்கு GSTIN கட்டாயம் இல்லை.
ta.partiesImport.customer_balance_help: பாசிட்டிவ் ஓப்பனிங் பேலன்ஸ்: கஸ்டமர் உங்களுக்குப் பணம் தரணும். நெகட்டிவ்: நீங்கள் கஸ்டமருக்குப் பணம் தரணும்.

ta.barcodes.help: பொருட்களுக்கு ஒரு உள் குறியீட்டை வழங்குங்கள், அல்லது சேமிக்கப்பட்ட பார்கோடை பதிவிறக்குங்கள். ஏற்கனவே உள்ள உற்பத்தியாளர் குறியீடுகள் அப்படியே இருக்கும்.

ta.barcodes.conflict_help: இந்த குறியீடுகள் ஒன்றுக்கு மேற்பட்ட பொருட்களுக்கு சொந்தமானவை. மேலாளர் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட பொருட்களுக்கு தனித்தனி குறியீடுகளை வழங்கி மறுபெயரிடும் வரை ஸ்கேன் செய்வது தடுக்கப்படும்.
